                  [3-507] section
                    [3-508] heading: Before you start
                    [3-510] list
                      [3-511] listitem
                        [3-512] ListMarker: •
                        [3-514] StaticText: Unplug USB before every wiring change.
                        [3-515] StaticText: Plug back in only to upload and test.
                      [3-516] listitem
                        [3-517] ListMarker: •
                        [3-519] StaticText: One common ground.
                        [3-520] StaticText: Every GND on every module goes to the same GND rail.
                      [3-521] listitem
                        [3-522] ListMarker: •
                        [3-524] StaticText: Two supply rails, never mixed.
                        [3-525] StaticText: 5V for the matrix, the AHCT125, the DAC module and the LEDs. 3V3 for every pull-up resistor and the MCP23017. No GPIO ever touches 5V directly.
                      [3-526] listitem
                        [3-527] ListMarker: •
                        [3-529] StaticText: Breadboard tip.
                        [3-530] StaticText: The DevKitC-1 is wide, so most breadboards leave no free hole on one side. Put it across two breadboards side by side, or use female-to-male jumpers from the headers.
                      [3-531] listitem
                        [3-532] ListMarker: •
                        [3-534] StaticText: Pins to leave alone:
                        [3-535] StaticText: GPIO0, 3, 45, 46 (boot straps), 19 and 20 (USB), 35 to 37 (used by the PSRAM inside the N16R8), 43 and 44 (serial console). They are grey on the map.
